subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Gregor MacGregor's Fake Country
description: Learn Gregor MacGregor's Fake Country in one minute.

hook.text: In 1822, a Scottish soldier convinced hundreds to invest in a country that didn't exist.

buildup.text: Gregor MacGregor called it Poyais — a tropical paradise in Central America.

discovery.text: He sold land titles, bonds, and even published a Poyais guidebook — all completely fake.

twist.text: Settlers who sailed there found only jungle. Many died of disease before rescue arrived.

climax.text: MacGregor fled to France and ran the same scam again. He was never seriously punished.

punchline.text: He sold a country that didn't exist — twice.

quiz.question: What was Poyais?
options: A real country in South America
A fictional country used to scam investors
